scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:terminal
scripts.build:renderer: tsc -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/styles.css dist/renderer/
scripts.build:terminal: esbuild src/renderer/terminal-renderer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/terminal-bundle.js --platform=browser && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css src/renderer/terminal.html dist/renderer/
